title: Logistic Regression + Isotonic Calibration: SOTA Brier 0.199 on NBA (MDPI Jan 2026)

sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
sources.key_finding: Logistic regression attains best Brier score among tabular baselines at 0.199. XGBoost 0.202. CNN model 0.221. MC-dropout RNN + shot-chart spatial embeddings also achieves 0.199.

sources.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
sources.key_finding: Stacked ensemble (NB + AdaBoost + MLP + KNN + XGB + DT + LR as meta-learner) achieves SOTA. Validates LR as meta-learner for CPU-legal stacked ensemble.

sources.title: Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA Leagues
sources.key_finding: CNN model achieves Brier 0.221. Baseline comparison confirms tree ensembles competitive at 0.202.

hypothesis: Adding logistic_regression to NBA island MODEL_TYPES allows GA to discover LR-based individuals. LR with isotonic calibration (already deployed on S15 as isotonic_temporal) may achieve Brier near 0.199 — a 10% improvement over current fleet-best.

steps: Edit S14 (Nomos42/nba-evo-5) app.py: add 'logistic_regression' and 'logistic_regression_brier' to MODEL_TYPES list
Add 'svm_platt' as secondary candidate (MDPI 2026 cites calibrated SVM 0.7749 accuracy)
Restart S14 Space to begin GA exploration of LR individuals
Monitor for 24h — if LR individuals reach top-5 by gen+50, port to S13/S18/S22
If LR achieves Brier <0.221 on any island → checkpoint + CLAUDE.md update
recommended_action.cpu_compatibility: LogisticRegression is CPU-legal (sklearn, no neural). SVM with Platt scaling also CPU-legal. Both compatible with Rule#8.
recommended_action.calibration_note: S15 already uses isotonic_temporal calibration for fleet-best 0.22012. Apply same calibration to LR individuals.

secondary_proposal.title: MC-dropout LSTM: GPU burst target
secondary_proposal.finding: MDPI Jan 2026 shows MC-dropout RNN + spatial shot-chart embeddings achieves Brier 0.199
secondary_proposal.action: Add to scripts/gpu-burst/ or scripts/kaggle/ Karpathy loop as GPU target
secondary_proposal.caveat: GPU-only (LSTM). Cannot run on CPU islands. Target: ZeroGPU burst or Kaggle P100.
secondary_proposal.shot_chart_note: Shot-chart spatial embeddings require play-by-play spatial data — not currently in features/engine.py. Would require new data pipeline step. Medium-term goal.

stacked_ensemble_proposal.title: LR meta-learner on XGB+ET+LGBM (CPU-legal)
stacked_ensemble_proposal.action: Add 'stacked_ensemble_lr_meta' as a MODEL_TYPE: base learners XGB+ET+LGBM, meta-learner LR. This is CPU-legal (no neural). Differs from banned 'stacking' which used neural meta-learner.
stacked_ensemble_proposal.distinction_from_banned_stacking: Rule#8 bans 'stacking' because it uses neural meta-learner on CPU. LR meta-learner is legal. Requires implementing stacked_ensemble_lr_meta as distinct model type in island app.py.

expected_impact.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH — MDPI 2026 peer-reviewed, NBA dataset 2024 season, comparable setup
expected_impact.caveat: Our features differ from paper (186 features vs paper's feature set). Actual improvement may be smaller. GA exploration needed.
